sub_graphs.name: Transaction Type Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Exception classes for validating transaction types per EIP-2718 encoding. TransactionTypeError is raised for unknown type bytes; TransactionTypeContractCreationError is raised when a transaction type that disallows contract creation attempts to create one.

invariants.text: Every transaction must have a recognized EIP-2718 type byte, or TransactionTypeError is raised.
BlobTransaction and SetCodeTransaction types must not create contracts (to field must be an Address), or TransactionTypeContractCreationError is raised.

functions.description: Stores the offending transaction type byte and produces an error message.
Stores the offending transaction object and produces an error message identifying the disallowed type.

fields.name: transaction_type
fields.description: The type byte of the transaction that caused the error.

fields.name: transaction
fields.description: The transaction that caused the error.

sub_graphs.name: Blob Transaction Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Exception classes specific to Type-3 (blob) transaction validation: gas limit, versioned hash format, blob count, blob data presence, and max fee per blob gas.

invariants.text: Blob gas used by a transaction must not exceed the block's blob gas limit (MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK), or BlobGasLimitExceededError is raised.
Every blob versioned hash must start with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01), or InvalidBlobVersionedHashError is raised.
A blob transaction must contain at least one blob, or NoBlobDataError is raised.
A blob transaction must not contain more than BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT (6) blobs, or BlobCountExceededError is raised.
The transaction's max_fee_per_blob_gas must be >= the calculated blob gas price, or InsufficientMaxFeePerBlobGasError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Gas Fee Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Exception classes for EIP-1559 fee market validation: insufficient max fee per gas and priority fee exceeding max fee.

invariants.text: For EIP-1559+ transactions, max_fee_per_gas must be >= block base_fee_per_gas, or InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError is raised.
For EIP-1559+ transactions, max_fee_per_gas must be >= max_priority_fee_per_gas, or PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError is raised.

functions.description: Stores the transaction's max fee and the block's base fee for diagnostic comparison.

fields.name: transaction_max_fee_per_gas
fields.description: The maximum fee per gas specified in the transaction.

fields.name: block_base_fee_per_gas
fields.description: The base fee per gas of the block.

sub_graphs.name: Miscellaneous Transaction Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Exception classes for authorization list validation (EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction), init code size limits, and per-transaction gas limits (EIP-7825).

invariants.text: SetCodeTransaction must have a non-empty authorization list, or EmptyAuthorizationListError is raised.
Contract creation init code must not exceed the maximum allowed size, or InitCodeTooLargeError is raised.
A transaction's gas limit must not exceed the per-transaction maximum (EIP-7825), or TransactionGasLimitExceededError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Fork Constants and Configuration
sub_graphs.description: Module-level constants defining block size limits (EIP-7934), gas parameters, blob schedule, system contract addresses, and PoS configuration values.

invariants.text: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE is 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB) per EIP-7934.
MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE = MAX_BLOCK_SIZE - SAFETY_MARGIN = 10,485,760 - 2,097,152 = 8,388,608 bytes.
BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT is 6, limiting the maximum number of blobs per transaction.
MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK = BLOB_SCHEDULE_MAX * GAS_PER_BLOB, derived from the blob gas schedule.
VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG = 0x01 for KZG commitment verification.
ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER = 2; BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR = 8 (EIP-1559 parameters).
GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM = 5000; GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR = 1024.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: History of blocks in the chain.

sub_graphs.name: Block State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Core state_transition function that applies a block to the chain. Validates RLP block size against MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (EIP-7934), validates the header, executes apply_body, and verifies all post-execution roots, blooms, gas used, blob gas used, and requests hash match the header commitments.

invariants.text: RLP-encoded block size must not exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (8,388,608 bytes), or InvalidBlock is raised.
Block must have empty ommers tuple (PoS), or InvalidBlock is raised.
After execution: block_output.block_gas_used must equal header.gas_used.
After execution: computed transactions_root must equal header.transactions_root.
After execution: computed state_root must equal header.state_root.
After execution: computed receipt_root must equal header.receipt_root.
After execution: computed logs_bloom must equal header.bloom.
After execution: computed withdrawals_root must equal header.withdrawals_root.
After execution: block_output.blob_gas_used must equal header.blob_gas_used.
After execution: computed requests_hash must equal header.requests_hash.
Chain retains at most 255 most recent blocks after appending the new block.

preconditions.text: The chain must have at least one existing block (parent) before state_transition can be called.

postconditions.text: On success, the block is appended to chain.blocks and chain.state reflects all state changes.

functions.description: Applies a block to the chain after full validation of header, body execution, and post-state verification.
Transforms state from previous hard fork. Currently a no-op identity function for Osaka.
Returns hashes of the previous 256 blocks for BLOCKHASH opcode support.

sub_graphs.name: Header Validation
sub_graphs.description: validate_header checks all header fields against protocol rules: block number sequencing, timestamp ordering, gas limit bounds, base fee calculation, excess blob gas, PoS fields (difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers_hash), extra_data size, and parent hash linkage.

invariants.text: header.number must be >= 1.
header.excess_blob_gas must equal calculate_excess_blob_gas(parent_header).
header.gas_used must not exceed header.gas_limit.
header.base_fee_per_gas must equal calculated expected_base_fee_per_gas from parent.
header.timestamp must be strictly greater than parent_header.timestamp.
header.number must equal parent_header.number + 1.
header.extra_data length must be <= 32 bytes.
header.difficulty must be 0 (PoS).
header.nonce must be 8 zero bytes (PoS).
header.ommers_hash must equal EMPTY_OMMER_HASH (PoS).
header.parent_hash must equal keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)).

functions.description: Verifies all header fields are consistent with parent block and protocol rules.

sub_graphs.name: Base Fee Calculation (EIP-1559)
sub_graphs.description: Calculates the EIP-1559 base fee per gas for a block based on parent block utilization relative to the gas target (gas_limit / ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER). Fee adjusts up when above target, down when below, capped by BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR.

invariants.text: Gas limit must pass check_gas_limit validation against parent, or InvalidBlock is raised.
When parent_gas_used == parent_gas_target, base fee remains unchanged.
When parent_gas_used > parent_gas_target, base fee increases by at least 1.
When parent_gas_used < parent_gas_target, base fee decreases (can reach 0).
Maximum base fee change per block is bounded by parent_base_fee / BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR (= 12.5%).

functions.signature: calculate_base_fee_per_gas(block_gas_limit: Uint, parent_gas_limit: Uint, parent_gas_used: Uint, parent_base_fee_per_gas: Uint) -> Uint
functions.description: Computes the EIP-1559 base fee for the current block from parent block parameters.

sub_graphs.name: Gas Limit Validation
sub_graphs.description: Validates that a block's gas limit is within the allowed adjustment range from the parent block's gas limit and above the minimum.

invariants.text: gas_limit must be < parent_gas_limit + (parent_gas_limit // GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR).
gas_limit must be > parent_gas_limit - (parent_gas_limit // GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR).
gas_limit must be >= GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000).

functions.description: Returns True if gas limit is within bounds of parent ± max_adjustment_delta and above minimum.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Inclusion Check
sub_graphs.description: Validates that a transaction is includable in the block: checks gas availability, blob gas availability, sender recovery, fee market rules (EIP-1559), blob-specific rules (EIP-4844), SetCode rules (EIP-7702), nonce matching, balance sufficiency, and EOA sender validation.

invariants.text: tx.gas must not exceed remaining block gas (block_gas_limit - block_gas_used).
Transaction blob gas must not exceed remaining block blob gas (MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK - blob_gas_used).
For EIP-1559+ txs: max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas.
For EIP-1559+ txs: max_fee_per_gas >= block base_fee_per_gas.
For legacy txs: gas_price >= block base_fee_per_gas.
For blob txs: blob_count must be in [1, BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT].
For blob txs: all versioned hashes must start with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG.
For blob txs: max_fee_per_blob_gas >= calculated blob_gas_price.
For BlobTransaction/SetCodeTransaction: tx.to must be an Address (no contract creation).
For SetCodeTransaction: authorization list must be non-empty.
Sender nonce must exactly match account nonce.
Sender balance must be >= max_gas_fee + tx.value.
Sender must be an EOA (no code, or valid delegation per EIP-7702).

functions.signature: check_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, tx: Transaction) -> Tuple[Address, Uint, Tuple[VersionedHash, ...], U64]
functions.description: Validates transaction inclusion eligibility, returns (sender_address, effective_gas_price, blob_versioned_hashes, tx_blob_gas_used).

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Execution and Gas Accounting
sub_graphs.description: Executes a single transaction: validates, deducts gas fees and blob fees from sender, processes the message call via the EVM, applies EIP-7623 calldata floor gas cost, refunds unused gas to sender, transfers priority fees to coinbase, destroys marked accounts, and records receipts.

invariants.text: Gas refund is capped at tx_gas_used_before_refund / 5.
Effective gas used is max(gas_used_after_refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost) per EIP-7623.
Sender balance is reduced by effective_gas_fee + blob_gas_fee before execution, then refunded unused gas after.
Coinbase receives priority_fee_per_gas * tx_gas_used_after_refund.
block_output.block_gas_used is incremented by tx_gas_used_after_refund.
block_output.blob_gas_used is incremented by tx_blob_gas_used.

preconditions.text: Transaction must pass validate_transaction (intrinsic gas) and check_transaction (inclusion checks).

postconditions.text: Receipt is stored in receipts_trie, transaction is stored in transactions_trie, logs are appended to block_logs.

functions.signature: process_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, tx: Transaction, index: Uint) -> None
functions.description: Full transaction execution pipeline: validation, fee deduction, EVM execution, gas refund (with EIP-7623 floor), fee transfer, receipt creation.

functions.signature: make_receipt(tx: Transaction, error: Optional[EthereumException], cumulative_gas_used: Uint, logs: Tuple[Log, ...]) -> Bytes | Receipt
functions.description: Constructs and encodes the receipt for an executed transaction.

sub_graphs.name: Block Body Execution
sub_graphs.description: Orchestrates block body execution: runs unchecked system transactions for beacon roots (EIP-4788) and history storage, processes all user transactions, processes withdrawals, and processes general-purpose requests (deposits, withdrawal requests, consolidation requests).

invariants.text: Beacon roots system transaction is executed first (unchecked) with parent_beacon_block_root as data.
History storage system transaction is executed second (unchecked) with parent hash as data.
All user transactions are decoded and processed sequentially in order.
Withdrawals are processed after all transactions.
General-purpose requests are processed last (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations).

functions.signature: apply_body(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, transactions: Tuple[LegacyTransaction | Bytes, ...], withdrawals: Tuple[Withdrawal, ...]) -> vm.BlockOutput
functions.description: Executes the full block body: system txs, user txs, withdrawals, requests.

sub_graphs.name: System Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Three variants of system transaction processing: base process_system_transaction constructs a Message from SYSTEM_ADDRESS with SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS; checked variant requires code presence and successful execution; unchecked variant silently handles missing code or failures.

invariants.text: System transactions originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe).
System transactions use SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000) gas.
System transactions transfer zero value and have no blob versioned hashes or authorizations.
Checked system transactions raise InvalidBlock if target has no code or if execution errors.
Unchecked system transactions silently proceed regardless of code presence or execution outcome.

functions.signature: process_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, system_contract_code: Bytes, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Base system transaction processor: constructs TransactionEnvironment and Message, calls process_message_call.

functions.signature: process_checked_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Checked variant: raises InvalidBlock if no code or execution error.

functions.signature: process_unchecked_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Unchecked variant: silently proceeds even with missing code or errors.

sub_graphs.name: General Purpose Requests Processing
sub_graphs.description: Processes EL-triggered requests: deposit requests parsed from receipts, withdrawal requests from the withdrawal request predeploy, and consolidation requests from the consolidation request predeploy. Requests are ordered by ascending type.

invariants.text: Requests must be in ascending order of request type: DEPOSIT < WITHDRAWAL < CONSOLIDATION.
Withdrawal request predeploy must have code and execute successfully (checked system transaction).
Consolidation request predeploy must have code and execute successfully (checked system transaction).
Request data is only appended if return_data is non-empty.

functions.description: Processes deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation requests in ascending type order.

sub_graphs.name: Withdrawal Processing
sub_graphs.description: Processes beacon chain withdrawals by crediting Gwei amounts (converted to Wei) to recipient accounts and recording withdrawals in the withdrawals trie.

invariants.text: Withdrawal amount is converted from Gwei to Wei by multiplying by 10^9.
Each withdrawal is RLP-encoded and stored in the withdrawals trie with its sequential index key.

functions.signature: process_withdrawals(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, withdrawals: Tuple[Withdrawal, ...]) -> None
functions.description: Credits withdrawal amounts to recipient addresses and records in withdrawals trie.
